newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close lower in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close lower in cautious trade.

text.p: Delhi shares closed lower on Tuesday as foreign investors sold stocks selectively and speculators adopted a cautious approach ahead of a Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) meeting, brokers said.

They said local mutual funds also restricted their buying activity on hopes that SEBI would discuss a revised carry-forward trading system proposed by the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) at its meeting in New Delhi on Wednesday.
The Delhi bourse's benchmark index closed 1.33 points down at 784.60.

"It seems that the operators adopted a cautious approach ahead of tomorrow's SEBI board meeting to consider revised carry-forward system proposed by BSE," said Vijay Aggarwal of brokers Mass Financial Services.
Reliance Industries ended 0.15 rupee down at 290.30.
State Bank of India quoted 1.75 rupees lower at 316.20.
Larsen and Toubro shed 4.10 rupees at 228.35.
